title: Annual Marriages
description: Number of marriages registered annually in Malaysia, including marriage rates per 1,000 unmarried population.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date of marriage registration in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 as this is annual data

fields.name: abs
fields.title: Number of Marriages
fields.description: [Integer] Number of marriages registered in that year

fields.name: rate
fields.title: Marriage Rate
fields.description: [Float] Number of marriages per 1000 currently unmarried population of the same sex (including widowers and divorcees)

methodology: In Malaysia, there are two parallel systems for marriage registration; non-Muslim marriages are registered with the National Registration Department (JPN), while Muslim marriages are registered with the Syariah Court. This dataset is tabulated from the transactional administrative data collected by both administrative systems.
caveat: The data represents registered marriages only. Unregistered marriages (including couples originally registered outside Malaysia who have not yet registered their marriage with local authorities) are not included in this dataset.
